note: Round 11: one console the width of the screen. The minimap block (the idle and army tab on its top edge, Diplomacy or Terrain, Messaging and APM in a bar, the minimap, a side module with the clock) and the command block (the Game Menu over the portrait, level with the groups, the portrait on the card's foot, the card in nine wells) stand on a plated deck that lengthens between them, with the ten groups in a tab at its left end, a light along its top and Hyperion's selection in a window as long as the deck. The resources hang from the top, right of centre or at the right edge as the player picks, on a plate or none. At Width 16:9 the console keeps to a 16:9 screen's width in the middle of a wider one, and the deck runs on past the blocks to the screen's edges. Built by huds/kits/build-mech.mjs from the parts in mech-parts.mjs. Hyperion's copy: no game timer in the skin; the time slot and its cell are left out. No flash on a new selection. Hyperion's copy: the selection's grid shows at most 8 columns, 24 units a page as StarCraft II's (the user, 2026-10-23).

options.label: Width
options.help: 16:9 keeps the console as wide as a 16:9 screen's, in the middle of a wider one, so the minimap and the command card stay where your hands know them; past it the console's deck runs on to the edges. On a 16:9 screen or a narrower one the two are the same.

values.label: Full screen
values.help: The HUD runs the width of the screen.
The HUD keeps to the middle of a wider screen, as wide as a 16:9 screen's.

options.label: Resources
options.help: Right of centre is where classic StarCraft has them, the top right of the screen's middle 4:3, so on a wide screen they stay near the middle. Right edge puts them in the top right corner, however wide the screen.

options.label: Resources backing
options.help: The plate behind minerals, gas and supply, with its cells and lights. With none, the icons and figures stand on the map, as they do in classic StarCraft.
